Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And others are hopeful of Allah's Command'

He said: A group who were polytheists killed the likes of Hamza and Ja'far and similar ones from the believers. Then they entered into Islam, acknowledged Allah and left polytheism, but did not recognize faith with their hearts. So they are considered among the believers and Paradise becomes obligatory for them. And they were not upon their denial to disbelieve so Hellfire becomes obligatory for them. So they are in that state: either He will punish them or He will accept their repentance.
ai.seo_question: Who are the 'hopeful' mentioned in Surah At-Tawbah 9:106 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the fate of the 'Murja'ah' (those who deferred judgment) by describing polytheists who killed companions like Hamza and Ja'far, later converted outwardly but lacked inner conviction. It highlights the Shia theological nuance that while their outward profession makes them technically believers entitled to Paradise, their specific sin of killing martyrs places them in a state of divine suspense where Allah may either punish or forgive them, reflecting the concept of 'Amr Allah' (Allah's Command).
